entries.reason: The answer key marks A ('Drive no faster than 50km/hour'), but the artwork is a solid blue disc reading 50. The manual (folio 39, regulatory sign #14, 'Minimum Speed') defines that sign as 'Maintain or exceed the minimum speed indicated'. The separate 'shall not exceed' sign is #44. The key's option A describes a maximum-speed sign.

The two mark-ups of this paper disagree on these 7 of the 79 questions both mark (91% agreement). Test_paper_with_answers.pdf is used as the key because its marks are systematic, but a disagreement rate this high means neither can be assumed correct on the questions where they differ.
